component.name: ENG Drawing Viewer
component.summary: View, mark up and convert engineering drawings offline

description.p: A free, offline workspace for engineering drawings. View folders of PDF drawings and images sharply at any zoom, mark them up with numbered review comments, edit images, vectors and PDFs, convert them with offline PDF tools and turn them into PowerPoint slides, all on your own computer.

ul.li: Folders and nested subfolders of PDFs and images, with thumbnails and natural sorting
MARK: pens, highlighters, arrows, circles, text and numbered callouts with comments
Image, Vector (SVG and DXF) and PDF editing
No account, no telemetry and no network connections
